It is located at the northeast corner of Oregon and comprises Oregon Route 82, Forest Roads 39 and 3365, and most of Oregon Route 86.  From the west, the byway begins at the intersection of Oregon Route 82 and Interstate 84 near La Grande and ends near Baker City, at the junction of Interstate 84 and Oregon Route 86.  It is 218.4 miles (351.5 km) long.
New Mexico State Road 161 | State Road 161 is a 31.9 mi long state highway in northeastern New Mexico.  NM 161 begins in the west at its junction with New Mexico State Road 518 several miles south of the unincorporated community of La Cueva. From there, the road turns northeast and briefly parallels I-25 before cutting back to the northwest for roughly seven miles before terminating at Fort Union National Monument. Springfield Junction (Long Island Rail Road) | Springfield Junction was a junction between the Long Island Rail Road's Montauk Branch and Atlantic Branch in Laurelton, Queens, New York City, United States. No rail station was located at the junction itself, however Springfield Gardens station was located nearby.

The route runs on mostly new road, built to facilitate the M50 and Dundrum Town Center and is 2.5 km (1.5 miles) long.
Ohio State Route 17 | State Route 17 (SR 17) is an east–west highway in Northeast Ohio running from North Olmsted at State Route 10 to State Route 43 in Bedford Heights. It also has two direct junctions with the interstate.  State Route 17 provides access to many industrial and commercial areas in this area of Cleveland.
M-39 (Michigan highway) | M-39 is a 16 mi long state trunkline highway in Metro Detroit area of the US state of Michigan that runs from Lincoln Park, on the south end, to Southfield on the north.  The official southern terminus of M-39 is at the corner of Southfield Road and Lafayette Boulevard in Lincoln Park, one block southeast of the junction of Interstate 75 (I-75, Fisher Freeway) and two blocks northwest of M-85 (Fort Street). The northern terminus is at M-10 (Lodge Freeway) in Southfield.
